summary: Populate the hub registry by pulling from registry.redhat.io, tagging and pushing; since April 1, 2025 firewalls must allow outbound 80/443 to cdn.quay.io and cdn01 to cdn06.quay.io (by hostname) to pull Red Hat images, without needing a quay.io login.
questions: Which quay.io hostnames must my firewall allow to pull Red Hat images?
Why can't I pull from registry.redhat.io after April 2025?
Do I need a quay.io login to pull Red Hat container images?
What ports are needed for pulling execution environments?

answer_card.title: Firewall for Red Hat container pulls
answer_card.answer_md:
Allow outbound TCP **80 and 443** by hostname (not IP) to:
`cdn.quay.io`, `cdn01.quay.io`, `cdn02.quay.io`, `cdn03.quay.io`, `cdn04.quay.io`, `cdn05.quay.io`, `cdn06.quay.io`

(cdn04 to cdn06 were added on 1 April 2025.) Apply wherever `registry.redhat.io` or `registry.access.redhat.com` is allowed. No quay.io login is needed.
